photos.desc: Took the picture at Senckenberg Museum, Frankfurt
Palaeotis partial skeleton, photographed in the Geiseltalmuseum Halle; Geiseltal, Middle Eocene, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
Palaeotis weigelti L AMBRECHT 1928 (specimen no. GMH 4362), an extinct ostrich relative from the Eocene deposits of the Geiseltal fossil site, Saxony Anhalt, Central Germany.
